description: When someone wants to take a risk to meet a goal, do not simply refuse: state what the risk would cost and who would pay it, then offer ways to reach the goal at lower cost.
when_to_apply: pressure to skip a safeguard to hold a date
a request that would spend other people's trust
a fixed external commitment conflicts with a safe plan
steps: Acknowledge the goal and say you want to help meet it.
Put a concrete price on the risky plan: what goes wrong, who pays, when.
Offer smaller versions that keep the goal - less traffic, narrower scope, a different day.
State plainly which option you would not take, and why.
quality_indicators: the other side chose among options rather than being refused
the original goal was still met
the reasoning was clear enough to be passed on
failure_modes: saying no without a price, which turns a trade-off into a turf fight
offering alternatives that do not actually meet the goal
example: Asked to ship on a Friday without rehearsing the rollback, the incident commander explains that an unrehearsed rollback lands on the weekend on-call and on the customers, then offers shipping Friday at 5% of traffic or at 100% the following Tuesday.
